Generated by tools/figures/art_readme.py from the hand-written concept-art page, the files and the records. AI concept art, not engineering: no dimension, clearance or safety property may be read from these

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAD = computer-aided design · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05,
CL-05 the reference layout) · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence
level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · M1, M2 … = mitigation in a hazard record (M1, M2 …), or a SysML model check rule in tools/sysml · SysML = Systems
